footer.testnetDisclaimer: Testnet deployment. No real funds, and no patient health information is stored on chain — vouchers reference a service category and an opaque beneficiary reference only.
footer.mainnetDisclaimer: No patient health information is stored on chain — vouchers reference a service category and an opaque beneficiary reference only.

common.indexerCatchUp: Lists update once the indexer catches up.

voucher.patientReferenceNote: The patient reference is an opaque hash. It cannot be turned back into a name or record number.
voucher.presentNote: Show this QR code upon arrival at the clinic. The desk can scan it instantly to look up and claim your voucher.
voucher.presentNotice: Present this number or QR code at the clinic reception desk.
voucher.ledgerNote: This voucher represents an escrowed commitment on the Stellar ledger. It contains no personally identifiable medical or identity records.
voucher.reportProblemIntro: Only the funder can open a dispute. If you are the patient, a relative, or anyone else who has noticed a problem with this voucher, open a report. It is prefilled with the public voucher number, status, service and clinic only — never the patient reference.

clinic.title: Clinic desk
clinic.noServices: No services listed yet. Funders can only pay for services you list.
clinic.delistNote: Delisting stops new vouchers for this service. Vouchers already funded keep their agreed amount and settle normally.
clinic.serviceNote: Use a coarse service category, never a diagnosis. Codes are public. A new price applies to vouchers funded from now on.
clinic.noIncoming: No vouchers for this clinic yet.
clinic.earningsNote: Cash flow for this clinic: settled care, payouts still in flight, and the protocol fees paid.
clinic.earningsPendingDetail: {count} claimed, attested or disputed, before fees
clinic.earningsMonthlyNote: Grouped by the month each voucher was funded (UTC).
clinic.earningsEmpty: No settled or pending earnings yet.
clinic.earningsUnavailable: Earnings are temporarily unavailable. The rest of the desk still works.
clinic.connectWallet: Connect the clinic's wallet to manage this desk.

checklist.title: Getting to your first payment
checklist.note: Five steps from registering to money in the bank. Each step turns green as it is completed.
checklist.allDone: All five steps are complete. Settled payments appear in Earnings.

hints.register: Fill in the form below with the clinic name and country code.
hints.waitingVerification: An administrator must verify the clinic. This page updates when it happens.
hints.suspended: This clinic is suspended. Contact the administrator to restore it.
hints.listService: Add your first service and price below so funders can buy it.
hints.claimVoucher: A voucher is waiting below. Mark the patient seen to claim it.
hints.shareClinic: Share your clinic page so funders can find you. When a voucher arrives, mark the patient seen.
hints.waitingAttester: Care has been claimed. An independent attester confirms it before payment.
hints.waitingDisputeWindow: Care is confirmed. The payment releases once the dispute window closes.
hints.disputed: A dispute is open, so the payment is frozen until an administrator resolves it.
hints.releasePayment: A confirmed voucher is ready below. Release the payment to receive the money.

scanner.title: Scan patient voucher QR
scanner.instructions: Point the camera at the patient's voucher QR code to open it automatically.
